payload.title: File:Chasmosaurus OC Harfa Praha B.jpg
payload.description_html:
* A model of the dinosaur Chasmosaurus in Prague's Harfa Dinosaur Park on the roof of the Galerie Harfa shopping centre (located at the address: OC Galerie Harfa, Českomoravská 15a, 190 93 Prague 9). GPS coordinates: N50° 06' 16.323", E14° 29' 30.761"
  • Time: Mesozoic, Upper Cretaceous, 76 to 72 million years ago; site: Canada; food: herbivore; length: 5 meters.
